# QtBase 6.11.2 original source notices

The eight files in headers/ preserve exact source bytes from the pinned QtBase release archive. The index records each archive member, byte range and SHA-256. They supplement the original Qt attribution records and license texts in the materialized notice bundle.

MD4, MD5 and SHA-1 retain their source notices without normalizing their attribution or custom license identifiers. Emoji Segmenter retains its Google Apache-2.0 header; binary inclusion depends on Qt configuration. The Khronos excerpts preserve the source copyright years alongside the separately bundled MIT license.

This is source evidence, not proof of package membership, corresponding source, complete shipped notices, or licensing clearance. SDK module selection alone does not establish which DLLs ship.
